hook.text: In May 2022, $60 billion vanished in 72 hours. Terra's stablecoin lost its peg and Luna went to zero.

buildup.text: Terra offered 20% yields on deposits. Investors deposited billions, drawn by returns no bank could match.

discovery.text: The system was algorithmic—no real assets backed the stablecoin. Trust in the algorithm was the only collateral.

twist.text: When confidence broke, the algorithm couldn't stabilize. It entered a death spiral: selling created more selling.

climax.text: The founder was later arrested. But the real lesson is that unsustainable yields always end the same way.

punchline.text: Twenty percent returns. Zero percent chance it lasts.

quiz.question: What backed Terra's stablecoin?
options: An algorithm with no real assets
